content: Fiye 50:1-14 Yakop Wenefalagiŋ.
Yakop kumumbuune Yosepdi beu tobooŋa koola siŋgoŋgomeguk.
Unduŋ tiŋa tipilapilaye meŋiye eŋ haguo meŋiye adi beu’walaŋ sigiŋ gitnem pilap mu bitakadok haguwo goomindok yeniŋguk. Kaŋ adi Yakop haguwo goomiŋgiŋ.
Kwanai u hatitulune melenai 40 tuguk. Nai yagigi undugoŋ tagiŋ. Kaŋ metam Isiphi adi Yakopdok makunum melenai 70 tigiŋ.
Makunum dapmaune Yosepdi Felo meeŋimeeŋiye indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Hidi nutok nemek momooŋ niŋ tinamunee nadiiŋ kaŋ nutok kibikooŋ Felo indiŋ nineeŋ,
‘Baatne adi indiŋ nifafaŋedok yoguk, “Nu kumumbeene dabaaŋne Kanaaŋ kwetneŋ kawade ginaaŋniŋ naatok waamukut, uŋgoŋ nehiwenewaaŋ.” Nu wondok-ku tiŋa wooŋ baatne wenefalaŋa kotigoŋ bubundok yolat.’”
Kaŋ Felodibo yoguk, “Kedeem yolaŋ undugoŋ tibeŋ. Tiŋa medege yofafaŋe tuguŋ undugoŋ wooŋ baha wenefalaaweŋ.”
Kaŋ Yosep adi beu wenefalaawene uguk. Kaŋ Felo tipilapilaye meŋiye eŋ talitimeŋhiye eŋ Isiphi me loloŋnit adi maaŋ wanaŋ ugiŋ.
Tiŋa Yosep eŋ Isilae neehi’walaŋ wapmihitam eŋ mehimehiye wanakaŋ hogohogok udapmagiŋ. Wapmihi kuyakuya eŋ kale makau heki hogok adi Gosen kwetneŋ uŋgoŋ biyabuune hatigiŋ.
Kalis eŋ meeniŋ kale wosi foloŋ yawagiŋ adi maaŋ ugiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa metam fee hinek ugiŋ.
Kaŋ adi uge uge Goleŋ Atadi kwet, Yodan ime gagayeŋ uŋgoŋ usuwaaŋ makaham kakaaŋ tooŋa kisaŋ kookiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa Yosep adi beu doktiŋa kobulabulaye melenai 7 tuguk.
Unduŋ doktiŋa Kanaaŋhi uŋoŋ itouyagiŋdi yabunadiŋa yogiŋ, “Woŋ adi Isiphi kuyeŋ makunum tiiŋ oŋ.” Unduŋ yoŋa kwet wondok wou Abe Misilaim
yogiŋ, eŋ nai indidegoŋ uŋaakoŋ yoiŋ, ala kwet woŋ adi Yodan ime guŋaandiŋ hatak.
Yakop mihiŋiye adi ne yodakaleguk wondok tuwot tigiŋ.
Adi Kanaaŋ kwetneŋ tiŋa wooŋ Mamele kwetneŋ mele labulakneŋkade Makpela kwetneŋ kawade mage hakuk, Abalahamdi Hitaitniŋ me Efelon adi’walaniŋ me yehiweneŋdok tuwagukneŋ wenefalagiŋ.
Yosep adi beu wenefulaŋa ne eŋ daliye eŋ noliŋiye hogohogok adut beu wenefalane noŋgoŋ ugiŋ ala kotigoŋ udaneeŋ Isipde udapmagiŋ.
Fiye 50:15-21 Yosepdi daliye yeniwihiguk
Yosep daliye adi beehik kumumbuune kaŋ yogiŋ, “Tiyauge Yosep adi nemek kadakaniŋ timiŋgumun hogohogok wondok kibibo nemek mulabumuŋ neeŋ tinimbaakneŋ ala!”
Unduŋ yoŋa adi’walaŋkade mede indiŋ kameune uguk, “Bahadi kumumbe tiŋila indiŋ ninindakaleguk,

‘Yosep indiŋ nineeŋ, “Dakeye indi kadakaniŋ hogoli hinek tigamgumun wendiniŋ yom u fiit liliwenekutnimbaaŋ.” ‘Unduŋ doktiŋa yuku ganinadiyam oŋ, baha diniŋ Bepaŋ adi’walaŋ tipilapilaye heki hatiyam doktiŋa yomnik fiit liliwenekulaaŋ.” Kaŋ Yosepdi mede u nadiŋa makat kookuk.
Kaŋ daliye nehibo Yosep’walaŋ hebeŋ ginaŋ wooŋ namandahik tubuwopmobula yogiŋ, “Indi yadi tipilapilayegeye.”
Unduŋ tubune Yosepdi yeniŋguk, “Munta mu tineŋ! Nu Bepaŋ kwelineŋ mu yatat!
Hidi biyagoŋ mulabumuŋ mintanamdok nadiŋa tigiŋ. Iŋgoŋ Bepaŋ adi tubuudaneune nemek momooŋ mintaguk. Meeniŋ fee’walaŋ hatihatihik kedebadok nadiune unduŋ mintaguk u nai indidegoŋ miiŋgoŋ kayam.
Unduŋ doktiŋa munta mu tineŋ. Nu hide eŋ wapmihihiye wanakaŋ habudokooŋ hamtoiwaat.” Unduŋ yeniwihiŋa yeniŋkwelemaguk.
Fiye 50:22-26 Yosep Kumuŋguk.
Yosep ne eŋ beu’walaŋ kayoŋ bopŋiye Isip kwetneŋ hatigiŋ. Yosep adi guletŋiŋ 110 dapmaguk.
Unduŋ hatiŋa dadaŋiye Efalaim’walaŋ laŋiye mintaune yabuguk. Tiŋa Manase’walaŋ mihiŋiŋ Makili wapmihiŋiye maaŋ yoboguk.

Kaŋ Yosepdi dali kwayaŋiye indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Nu ya agaŋ kumumbaat. Bepaŋ adi yadi habudokooŋ hehitubulodawaak. Tiŋa kwet iŋaniŋ hanagila heheŋeŋ wooŋ kwet Abalaham, Aisak eŋ Yakop yenifafaŋegukneŋ uŋoŋ hamewaak.”
Unduŋ yoŋa Yosepdi Isilae mihiŋiye adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ namanda foloŋ mede yokwambundamindok yeniŋguk. Indiŋ yoguk, “Bepaŋdi hanagilaak nai uŋaniŋ kitiline wanaŋ tiŋa uneeŋ.”
Kaŋ Yosep adi guletŋiŋ 110 kaŋ kumuŋguk. Kumumbune sigiŋ gitnem pilap mu bitakadok haguwodi gomina Isip kwetneŋ kumuŋ bogit niŋ ginaŋ dahiŋa kameune hakuk.

footnotes.text: Abe Misilaim mebi adi Isiphi makunum tiiŋ.
